title: Reject malformed SDF IR instead of silently producing zero distance
description: Harden the SDF execution boundary against invalid SdfOperationType values and invalid operation references. SdfProgramEvaluator currently returns 0 for an unknown operation type in both EvaluateOperation and EvaluateSubtree, which can turn malformed internal IR into a valid-looking surface. Define one validation policy at the compiled-program boundary, add focused regression coverage, and preserve the existing +Infinity/NaN field contract. Do not add exceptions inside Burst hot loops unless the execution boundary is proven safe for the supported Unity/Burst configuration.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Current-head static audit 2026-09-12: SdfProgramEvaluator has default return 0f in both operation evaluators. This is unsafe for malformed IR because it manufactures a zero-distance surface. The preferred fix is boundary validation, not hot-loop exception control flow.
